scope: Actual Express/JWT/PostgreSQL with synthetic client/document records; no external messages, uploads, legal signatures or production proof
checks: Company-scoped client listing/detail/edit cannot reach another company or non-client staff
Client creation derives company and commits its audit; forged company fields are rejected
Actual client audit failure rolls back client creation
Legacy URL upload and pasted signature cannot create document bytes or signed state
Founder force-status cannot bypass signature evidence
Public portal contains only admitted client documents, not internal filing packets
Possession of a portal link cannot replace the login email
Inactive account revokes public portal access
Cross-company portal management, negative expiry and fake sent messages are rejected
Explicit copy returns a portal link while audit records omit its bearer token
Portal renewal and audit roll back together; successful response reports the actual renewed expiration
Alternate public case route excludes deleted documents and revoked client accounts
